recipes.name: Salisbury Steak
ingredients_raw: 1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed French onion soup

steps.text: Combine ground beef, 1/3 cup condensed soup, bread crumbs, egg, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat; add patties and brown on both sides. Drain excess fat.
Blend remaining soup and flour together in a small bowl until smooth; mix in ketchup, water, Worcestershire sauce, and mustard.

Pour soup mixture over patties in the skillet. Cover and reduce heat to low. Simmer until patties are cooked through and sauce has thickened, about 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

raw_recipe.headline: Salisbury Steak
raw_recipe.description: This Salisbury steak recipe browns beef patties and simmers them in a savory onion sauce. Delicious served with mashed potatoes for a comforting dinner.

review.reviewBody: This turned out to be a pleasant surprise. Here are the changes I made to what is now my favorite dish. In the gravy, I used a can of French Onion soup as well as a can of Cream of Mushroom and a packet of Dry Onion Soup. I omitted the salt due to the high sodium content in the soups. I'm glad I did. I doubled the gravy except for the ketchup...kept it at 1/4 cup while doubling the rest. I also added a jar of mushrooms to the gravy. After browning each side of the patties (and yes, having them fall apart slightly), I transferred the patties to a foil-lined casserole dish, put the gravy on top, covered the dish, and cooked it at 375 for 45 minutes. I was worried the patties wouldn't get all the way done because they were pretty thick, but they turned out perfect!!! We had it with brown rice (and had just enough wonderful gravy to go along with it!) and steamed broccoli. This is a new favorite recipe for my husband and me.

I only rate a recipe if I make it as is, I don't think it is fair to make changes and then rate a recipe. So as-is this recipe is really good, 4 stars. The second time I made it I followed other reviewers advice and added Cream of Mushroom soup and sauteed onions and that made it 5 stars!

The only reason I gave this recipe four stars is because I ended up doing a lot of tweaking based on other recommendations. I ended up with a WONDERFUL meal. I took the following suggestions: I added chopped onion and garlic to meat mixture before browning. I added a can of cream of mushroom soup to French onion soup, and mixed in a small amount of brown gravy mix to give it some color and thickened it up a bit. I omitted the ketchup and doubled the amount to pour on top of garlic mashed potatoes. For those who had trouble keeping the patties together, try this as was suggested before. Instead of cooking in a skillet, place browned patties in a foil-lined casserole dish, pour gravy over top, and bake at 400 for 30 mins. Your patties will stay together nicely!!

i have made this recipe now every week...my husband and kids love this...i use onion soup mix and 2cups of water instead...so i dont add any more water to the sauce..i also add onions to the beef and alittle more bread crumbs...thank you i will keep on cooking this...m

This was very good and so easy! I only made two changes: I used Onion Soup Mix in 1 1/2 cups water with a boullion cube and used brown gravy instead of ketchup (a family preference). Served them with garlic mashed potatoes - it was great!

Definitely needs qweaks! No ketchup! No mustard. No flour. No salt added anywhere - soup has lots already. Mix the partial can of French onion soup in with the hamburger as the recipe states. As well as the bread crumbs, black pepper, and egg. Get those grilling on your barbecue grill. For the gravy, add the remaining French onion soup to a sauce pan to make the gravy. I add an additional full can of French onion soup, add 2 cans of cream of mushroom soup. Add the Worcestershire and add a packet of dry Lipton Onion Soup. Add water until it’s a gravy thickness that you like. Grill the patties until Med well. Put in a 13x9 pan, pour the warmed gravy over the patties. Bake @ 20 mins at 350 until hot and bubbly. Superb! Got to have mashed potatoes with it!

This was outstanding! I followed the recipe exactly except that I first sliced a sweet onion paper thin, and caramelized it in a bit of butter, and I added it with the flour mixture at the end. I think this is the BEST Salisbury Steak I've ever had.

Doubled sauce with extra can of French Onion, can of cream of mushroon, and lipton soup packet. Omitted ketchup. Used Pino Noir instead of water. After browning, removed patties, sauteed mushrooms and onions in pan and scraped up bits with Pinot. Really added depth. SO loved it!!

This was really good. I did make some small changes to the recipe only because I didn't have all the ingredients on hand: Instead of using regular bread crumbs I used Kroger's garlic/onion/parsley croutons that I ground up; I used 1 can of beef consomme instead of onion soup; I added diced onion to the beef mixture.
The steaks turned out perfect, but I wasn't a fan of the gravy. The ketchup taste was too strong for me. Next time, I'll dial that back a bit, but the recipe is definitely a keeper.

It was super tasty! I’d make the sauce before browning the hamburger though, it makes it a bit easier. I didn’t have the condensed soup so I used beef broth and added a packet of Lipton’s instant onion soup/dip mix.
Made this for a church potluck lunch. I have had 6 people ask me for the recipe.
I’ve made this recipe 💯 times. My husband loves it. We normally serve with mashed potatoes 🥔. I’m doing egg noodles tonight!
Pretty good, only thing is a lot of extra grease leaked out into the sauce after browning them. This could probably be easily fixed by getting leaner meat, so still a 5 for me and my husband!
I did make small changes, I used regular French onion soup, elimated the water, and added beef gravy to the mix as it cooks ,everyone loves it

I made this exactly as the recipe called for without any changes. Excellent flavor and the consistency of the gravy was perfect with our preferences. Served over mashed potatoes. One of our favorite dishes.
This is a great recipe. I didn’t deviate from the recipe and it was very good. Buttered green beans and mashed potatoes were served with the recipe. Will definitely make this again
Not a fan - way too salty. Just use onions and skip the onion soup! Made way to much for a large skillet as mentioned by others.
The recipe was easy and savory. I only had 1 lb of hamburger, so the patties did not hold together. But the gravy was so wonderful that I served it with mashed potatoes. It was hard to stop eating!
Flavorful and great with mashed potatoes!
